name: Creamy Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and comforting chicken stew with vegetables in a creamy sauce.
recipeIngredient: 3 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a Dutch oven. Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper, and paprika. Cook and stir until the chicken is browned. Drain.
Add raw vegetables, basil, bay leaf, celery salt, and 5 cups broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Remove bay leaf. Add canned vegetables. Cook and stir for 2 minutes.
In a saucepan, mix flour and butter or margarine until smooth. Gradually whisk in remaining 2 cups broth. Bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
Pour the sauce into the Dutch oven. Stir and bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with rolls or biscuits.

keywords: chicken stew, creamy stew, comfort food

_similar.name: Chicken with a Chinese Accent
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a Chinese-inspired flavor profile, featuring soya sauce and brown sugar.

recipeInstructions.text: Fry chicken breasts in a frying pan with oil and soya sauce until the outsides are done.
Transfer the chicken to a casserole dish.
Mix the remaining ingredients with soya sauce and pour over the chicken.
Bake for 35 minutes at 350°F.
Serve the chicken with rice.

_similar.name: Easy Curried Chicken
recipeIngredient: Broccoli and carrots, cut into bite-size pieces

recipeInstructions.text: Grease the bottom of a pan and layer with vegetables.
Arrange chicken pieces on top of the vegetables.
Mix cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, and curry powder.
Pour the soup mixture over the chicken.
Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.
Bake at 375°F for 1 hour.

_similar.name: Favourite Chicken
_similar.description: A simple and satisfying chicken dish baked with cheddar cheese, mushroom soup, and garlic.
recipeIngredient: 1 can cheddar cheese soup (or other soup to taste)

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and pat dry chicken breasts.
Combine cheddar cheese soup, mushroom soup, and garlic powder. Mix well.
Place chicken in a 9x11 inch baking dish. Pour soup mixture over chicken.
Top with grated cheese and sliced mushrooms.
Bake at 350°F for about 1 hour for 4 pieces or 1½ hours for 6 pieces.
Check to ensure chicken is cooked through, as oven temperatures may vary.

_similar.keywords: baked chicken, cheddar cheese, mushroom soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Classy Chicken
_similar.description: A creamy, curry-flavored chicken dish with asparagus or broccoli and a cheddar cheese topping.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) pkg frozen asparagus or broccoli

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the chicken into 2×4 inch pieces and sprinkle with pepper.
Saute the chicken slowly in oil over medium heat until white and clear, about 6 minutes. Drain.
Cook asparagus or broccoli until tender crisp, drain, and arrange in the bottom of a buttered 7-inch diameter casserole dish.
Place the cooked chicken on top of the asparagus or broccoli layer.
Mix the cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, curry powder, and lemon juice together and pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake, uncovered, at 375 °F for 30 to 35 minutes.

_similar.keywords: creamy chicken, curry chicken, asparagus, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Chicken Breast
_similar.description: A simple breaded chicken breast recipe.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash chicken breast.
Sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, and seasoning.
Dip in milk, then egg mixture, then bread crumbs.
Bake in a 9x13 inch pan at 350°F until golden.
Serve with rice or noodles.
